_source: Seeded from the English-Somali Dictionary (Top 3500), admin.opentran.net/pdf/upload/en-so.pdf. Glosses were corrected to dictionary citation forms (definite-article suffixes stripped, wrong senses replaced); pronunciations and examples written by hand.
_pron: Respelling for English readers: ' = the throaty Somali c, kh = Somali x, q = a k made far back in the throat, dh = d with the tongue curled back.
